items.heading: Video Editing Is a Real,
items.text: Video editing is a real, growing field in India, not a dying craft and not a get-rich-quick shortcut either. But "is video editing good" and "will I personally land a good editing job easily" are two different questions, and most course-marketing pages blur them together until you cannot tell which one is being answered.

items.heading: Here Is the Part Most
items.text: Here is the part most "video editing scope" pages gloss over. The growing demand for edited video and an individual beginner's ease of getting hired next month are two different questions, and the gap between them is the actual source of "video editing is oversaturated" panic.

items.heading: "Video Editor Salary in India"
items.text: "Video editor salary in India" is close to a meaningless single number, because the spread between a certificate-only fresher and a specialised senior editor is enormous, and most course pages quote only the flattering end of it.
